text:
Harpreet Patel
Product Designer focused on consumer fintech and e-commerce interfaces | Ahmedabad, Gujarat
harpreet.patel233@example.com | +91 9896276863

Experienced product designer with a strong emphasis on user-centered design, rapid prototyping, and measurable UX improvements. I combine qualitative user research with execution in Figma to deliver polished interfaces that increase engagement and conversion. Not open to relocation; looking for roles in Ahmedabad only. Notice period: 60 days.

Experience

CartNest — Jul 2025 - Present
Product Designer (Hybrid)
- Led User Research initiatives across three customer segments, conducting 40+ interviews and synthesizing findings that informed a redesigned checkout flow, reducing abandonment by 18%.
- Drove UI/UX Design for a modular cart experience in Figma, shipping 8 high-fidelity screens and a component library that improved cross-team consistency and cut design handoff time by 30%.
- Built interactive Prototyping flows to validate promotional mechanics; A/B tests on prototypes showed a 12% lift in add-to-cart events.
- Established Git-based versioning for design assets and introduced Linux-friendly tooling and scripts to streamline asset exports for engineering.

Paystack India — Dec 2022 - Jun 2025
UI/UX Designer (Remote)
- Led User Research for merchant onboarding, running 25 diary studies and usability tests that identified friction points and enabled a redesigned onboarding funnel, improving completion rate by 22%.
- Executed end-to-end UI/UX Design in Figma for payment flows and dashboard components; launched a responsive dashboard that increased daily active merchants by 9%.
- Developed Prototyping simulations for new integrations and collaborated with engineering using Git-tracked design files to reduce iteration cycles by 25%.
- Implemented a usability metric dashboard tracking task success and time-on-task, informing incremental improvements that reduced average support tickets by 15%.

UrbanPantry — Mar 2021 - Nov 2022
UI/UX Designer (On-site)
- Conducted User Research (surveys and in-person sessions) uncovering top pain points in meal discovery; redesigned category and search UI which increased discovery clicks by 28%.
- Produced pixel-accurate UI/UX Design deliverables in Figma and maintained a component library that accelerated feature delivery across web and mobile.
- Built interactive Prototyping assets used in stakeholder demos and usability tests; prototype-driven changes led to a 14% improvement in conversion for new users.
- Partnered with engineering using Git for asset versioning and ensured production exports were compatible with Linux-based build servers.

Projects
- Checkout Microcopy Audit — Audited microcopy across CartNest flows, proposed 45 microcopy changes validated via hallway testing; expected to reduce support queries for failed payments by ~10%.
- Merchant Onboarding Kit — Packaged templates and Figma starter files for merchant onboarding at Paystack India, enabling new designers to onboard 40% faster.

Skills
Design Tools: Figma, Prototyping
Design Disciplines: UI/UX, User Research
Engineering & Tools: Git, Linux

Education
B.Tech, Electronics, NIT Trichy
